design.decision: Lead trumps early to pull the opponents' [♠] before they can ruff your side-suit winners, or to protect a partner's nil.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first early [♠] lead; opponents lose their trumps sooner and cannot rely on ruffing.
design.rationale: A familiar Spades rule bent in one direction, with standalone value for any long-trump or honor-heavy hand; seed-spade-lead (+7.1) suggests leading [♠] is valuable.
design.draftText: Your team can lead [♠] before [♠] are broken
design.hooks: A team-scoped rule flag that exempts the team from the 'spades must be broken before leading' restriction; following suit and trump priority unchanged

history.note: draft-common: merged into ca-lead-spades, an identical design from another cluster.

text: Your team can lead [♠] before [♠]s are broken
